title: UI Pattern 的生产实现必须以不可变 revision + source path + blob identity 建立可核验 Realization
summary: Pattern 描述可复用语义，Reference Demo 描述机制，而具体产品如何实现必须单独登记为 Platform Realization。Realization 绑定项目、平台、不可变 commit、源文件 blob、验证文件和限制；报告同时标记该 revision 是否仍等于项目当前 HEAD，避免把历史生产实现静默描述成当前实现。
principles: Pattern semantics, generic realization recipe, production realization and production visual evidence are separate evidence classes.
Production realization provenance uses an immutable repository revision and file blob identities.
Currentness is reported independently from source verification.
One production realization may implement several composable Patterns, and one Pattern may have several platform/project realizations.
Adaptive/conditional implementations record the conditions under which a Pattern is active or deliberately falls back.
Source-linked implementation evidence must not be presented as pixel/visual production evidence.
